description: Move, scale, rotate, reflect or shear the pattern inside objects without changing the objects (like the Transform options with Transform Objects off and Transform Patterns on, or dragging with the ` key held). Steps apply in that order: reflect, scale, rotate, shear, move

angle.description: Rotate the pattern by this many degrees, anticlockwise

dx.description: Move the pattern right by this many points

dy.description: Move the pattern down by this many points

origin.description: Point to transform around. Default center

paint.description: Which paint the pattern is in. Default fill

scaleX.description: Horizontal scale in percent; overrides scale

scaleY.description: Vertical scale in percent; overrides scale

shear.description: Shear the pattern horizontally by this angle in degrees

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: transform_pattern
title: Transform Pattern
